title: Code 3
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: understand the structure of a real-time computer graphics pipeline and the interaction of modern interfaces and current GPUs.
understand the factors influencing the performance of an application.
recognize and formulate the requirements for high-performance real-time computer graphics applications.
develop solution-oriented concepts for a complex problem in the context of programming.
get an overview of the architecture of a real-time media application.
evaluate the interaction of additional APIs in their own real-time computer graphics application.
